organization: Delaware Office of Veterans Services, Veteran Service Officers (Dover)
address: Robbins Building, 802 Silver Lake Blvd., Suite 100, Dover, DE 19904
source_title: Delaware Office of Veterans Services: Contact
note: The office is on the southeast side of the Robbins Building, facing Walker Road. Veteran Service Officers help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and state veterans benefits at no charge.

evidence.selection: Office address, phone and the Veteran Service Officers’ arrangement as printed on the Office of Veterans Services contact page; staff names omitted. The page says the service office is reached through the Dover headquarters and serves all three counties, so every county shows the Dover office.
